scripts.text:
[Tourist]
You're that meanie...
scripts.translation:
[游客]
你这个坏蛋……

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Aren't you...?
scripts.translation:
[游客]
难道不是吗……？

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Alright, alright, but you don't have to be mean.
scripts.translation:
[游客]
好吧，好吧，但你没必要这么刻薄。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
I didn't think you were that
mean. Scram, I ain't in the mood
to talk to you.
scripts.translation:
[游客]
没想到你居然这么坏。滚开，我现在没心情跟你说话。

scripts.text: So do you have business in Lutie?
scripts.translation: 那么，您有在姜饼城的事吗？

scripts.text: You don't want to go to Lutie for a tour.
scripts.translation: 您不想去姜饼城旅游。

scripts.text: What made you come over here?
scripts.translation: 是什么让您来到这里？

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Yes.
Well, actually...
scripts.translation:
[游客]
是的。
其实……

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
I wanted to give my girlfriend
some well baked cookies.
Sadly, in my hometown of
Morocc, we don't have fancy
foods like that.
scripts.translation:
[游客]
我想给我的女朋友买一些烤得很好的饼干。
可惜在我的家乡莫洛奇，没有这么精致的食物。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
I've been asking all these
merchants about it, and I was
told that I could only get them
in Lutie...that's my story.
scripts.translation:
[游客]
我问遍了这里的商人，他们告诉我只有在姜饼城才能买到……这就是我的故事。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Now I'm running out of money and
food...I can't stay here much longer...
scripts.translation:
[游客]
现在我的钱和食物都快用完了……我没法在这里多待了……

scripts.text: Do you want me to help you?
scripts.translation: 需要我帮你吗？

scripts.text: Well, good luck with everything.
scripts.translation: 祝你好运。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Thank god! Thank you so much.
I knew you would help me~!
scripts.translation:
[游客]
谢天谢地！太感谢你了。
我就知道你会帮我的~！

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Umm...
Before we talk about that help...
Er, hmmmm...
Well, you know I'm pretty
much starving to death now...
scripts.translation:
[游客]
那个……
在谈那个帮助之前……
呃，嗯……
你知道我现在快饿死了……

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Could you please get me some Meat?
I know I'm asking you too much,
but I'm pretty much penniless
so I don't really have much
of a choice...
scripts.translation:
[游客]
能请你给我买些肉吗？
我知道我要求太多了，
但我现在身无分文，
所以也没得选……

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
.........
How could you be so cold
hearted after hearing my story?
...You're pretty mean!
scripts.translation:
[游客]
………
听了我的故事你居然这么冷酷无情？
……你真的很坏！

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
...Oh really? Hmm...people said I
could only get the well baked
cookie in Lutie.
scripts.translation:
[游客]

I was told that I could only find
the entrance to Lutie in
Al De Baran...
scripts.translation:
[游客]
我听说，姜饼城的入口
只在艾尔帕兰……

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
So I came here after searching
for Al De Baran...almost
killing myself when I passed the desert...*Sob*
scripts.translation:
[游客]
所以我找遍了艾尔帕兰才来到这里……
穿越沙漠时差点要了我的命……*抽泣*

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
I see...I can understand that you
can't help me. It's alright...
It's not like I have the right
to demand anything of you...
But...
scripts.translation:
[游客]
我明白了……我理解你帮不了我。没关系的……
我也没资格要求你做什么……
但是……

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
*Sob*...so... hungry...
scripts.translation:
[游客]
*抽泣*……好……好饿……

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Ah...thanks! Thank you so much!
scripts.translation:
[游客]
啊……谢谢！太感谢你了！

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
I appreciate that you're
helping me out of the
goodness of your heart,
but...
scripts.translation:
[游客]
我很感激你出于好心帮助我，
但是……

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
What are you...
Cheap?! You can feed
a starving man more
than this...bring me
more Meat!
scripts.translation:
[游客]
你这是什么……
小气鬼！喂一个快饿死的人
这点哪够吃……
多给我带点肉来！

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
I appreciate you bringing
all this for me but...
scripts.translation:
[游客]
谢谢你给我带这么多，
但是……

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Geez, you want I should
choke myself to death?
I can't eat all of this!
Bring me less Meat, yeah?
scripts.translation:
[游客]
天哪，你是想让我撑死吗？
我吃不下这么多！
少带点肉来，行不行？

^3355FFHe seemed to have been
starving for a long time.
He ate all the meat I gave him
and it was all gone in a flash.^000000
^0000FF...Oh my! He took my cookies without even asking and ate all of those too!!^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF他看起来已经饿了很久了。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
*Phew*...thanks.
At long last...
I feel stuffed.
...Oh. Right.
My girlfriend.
scripts.translation:
[游客]
*呼*……谢谢。
终于……
我吃饱了。
……啊，对了。
我女朋友。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Er...about the well-baked
cookie I told you about? Um... I
know I'm being rude and selfish
...But I don't think I can find
it on my own.
scripts.translation:
[游客]
呃……就是我跟你说的那个姜饼？嗯……
我知道这样很没礼貌也很自私……
但我觉得自己可能找不到它。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
So, could you bring me ^0000FF20 Well-baked Cookies^000000?
scripts.translation:
[游客]
所以，能帮我带^0000FF20个姜饼^000000吗？

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Although I shouldn't be asking for
any more favors, and you'd have
to go through all this trouble...
while I'd be safe over here...
scripts.translation:
[游客]
虽然我不该再麻烦你，
而且你得费这么大劲……
而我却在这里安安稳稳的……

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
I really want to make my
girlfriend happy. Everything
would be worth it for
that smile on her face...
I just can't pass this chance up!
scripts.translation:
[游客]
我真的想让我女朋友开心。
为了她脸上的笑容，
一切都值得……
我不能错过这个机会！

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Haven't you been in love...?
Surely you understand the
sway that this woman has
over me! Otherwise...I'd be
selling jewels...anything
other than this.
scripts.translation:
[游客]
你没谈过恋爱吗……？
你肯定能理解这个女人
对我的吸引力吧！不然的话……
我宁愿去卖宝石……
也不会做这种事。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
I'm begging you, since you're
stronger and less delicate
than me, please bring me
^0000FF20 Well-baked Cookies^000000!
For me, it's impossible!!
scripts.translation:
[游客]
求求你了，既然你比我强壮，
也没我那么娇气，
请帮我带^0000FF20个姜饼^000000！
对我来说这根本做不到！！

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Ah~!! Thank you so much!!
There really are many good
people like you in this world.
scripts.translation:
[游客]
啊~！！太感谢你了！！
这个世界上果然有很多像你这样的好人。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
I appreciate what you've done for
me...now I can see her smile with
happiness.
scripts.translation:
[游客]
我很感激你为我做的一切……
现在我能看到她幸福的笑容了。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Hmm, there is still one problem
left for me though...How do I
get back home to Morocc??
Well, if it can make my girl
happy...
scripts.translation:
[游客]
嗯……不过还有一个问题……
我怎么才能回到莫洛奇呢？？
嗯……只要能让她开心……

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
...I'll get around to it.
Sooner or later. Man,
that desert's really big,
you know?
scripts.translation:
[游客]
……我会想办法的。
迟早的事。天哪，
这片沙漠真的很大啊，
你知道吗？

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
I see...I can understand that you
can't help me. It's alright...
It's not like I have the right
to demand anything of you...
But...
scripts.translation:
[游客]
我明白了……我理解你帮不了我。没关系的……
我也没资格要求你做什么……
但是……

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Thank you so much!
scripts.translation:
[游客]
非常感谢你！

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Hmm...I wanna pay you back...
And you're an adventurer...
But I don't got any like...
magic armor or those
cards you guys are
always playing with...
scripts.translation:
[游客]
嗯……我想报答你……
而且你也是冒险者……
但我没有那种……
魔法护甲，或者你们
总是玩的那些卡片……

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Hmmm...
....I got it!
Sooner or later, you
wanna visit some sort
of wise man or...
...something, right?
scripts.translation:
[游客]
嗯……
……我想到了！
迟早有一天，
你会去拜访某位智者，或者……
……什么的，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Visit my pal ^649664Jacob^000000 in
Morocc. Tell him that I
introduced you. He knows
about a wise man...
Though, he isn't one
himself...
scripts.translation:
[游客]
去莫洛奇拜访我的朋友^649664雅各布^000000。
告诉他是我介绍你来的。
他认识一位智者……
虽然他自己不算……

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Ah, sorry, I haven't even told
you my name. My name is...
^0000FFPandger Mayer^000000.
scripts.translation:
[游客]
啊，抱歉，我还没告诉你我的名字。
我的名字是……
^0000FF潘杰·梅耶^000000。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
So yeah, tell my pal Jacob
that Pandger Mayer introduced you.
scripts.translation:
[游客]
所以，告诉我的朋友雅各布，
是潘杰·梅耶介绍你来的。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
So...you tell 'em:
^0000FFPandger Mayer introduced you^000000
Exactly like that~
^0000FFPandger Mayer introduced you^000000
^FF0000Don't forget it~^000000
scripts.translation:
[游客]
所以……你就告诉他们：
^0000FF潘杰·梅耶介绍你来的^000000
就照原样说~
^0000FF潘杰·梅耶介绍你来的^000000
^FF0000别忘了哦~^000000

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Sorry I can't pay you back with
more than this, though. Kinda
stinks, huh?
scripts.translation:
[游客]
抱歉，我只能用这些来报答你了。
有点寒酸，是吧？

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Here, take this as an extra
token of my gratitute.
This doohickey has been
pretty handy in sticky
situations...
scripts.translation:
[游客]
拿着，这个作为额外的谢礼。
这个小玩意在紧要关头
还挺好用的……

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Hopefully, it'll be useful.
Umm...it seems you're carrying too much stuff with you.
Doncha want me to help you?
scripts.translation:
[游客]
希望它能派上用场。
嗯……看起来你带的东西太多了。
要不要我帮你？

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Hopefully, it'll be useful.
scripts.translation:
[游客]
希望它能派上用场。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Heh...once gain, thanks for
the help. Take care, guy.
scripts.translation:
[游客]
嘿……再次感谢你的帮助。
保重，盖伊。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Hey, thanks a bunch for your
help. Anyways...now I remember
I gotta go back through the
desert again...*Sigh*
Yeah, I better get back...
scripts.translation:
[游客]
嘿，非常感谢你的帮助。
总之……现在我想起来了，
我还得穿过沙漠回去……*叹气*
是啊，我得回去了……

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
...no matter how hard it is.
But...yeah. It's gonna be pretty
hard. Crossing the desert...
alone. By myself...crud.
scripts.translation:
[游客]
……不管有多难。
但是……是啊。会很艰难。
独自穿越沙漠……
就我一个人……该死。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Hey, thanks a bunch for your
help....I ain't sure if I
can make it back to Morocc
in one piece...
scripts.translation:
[游客]
嘿，非常感谢你的帮助……
我不确定我能不能完好无损地回到莫洛奇……

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
But I better go back
to my girlfriend. That's
the point of me coming
here in the first place,
anyway.
scripts.translation:
[游客]
但我得回到我女朋友身边。
这就是我来的目的，
无论如何。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Hey, thanks a bunch for your
help. Man...Morocc is a long
way off, isn't it? Aw nuts...
I guess if I was crazy
enough to come here because
of my girlfriend...
scripts.translation:
[游客]
嘿，非常感谢你的帮助。
天哪……莫洛奇离这里好远啊，
不是吗？真糟糕……
我想，既然我为了女朋友
都敢来这里……

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
I'm crazy enough to walk all
way back to Morocc...
...
...unless...
You'll gimme a piggy-back ride?
scripts.translation:
[游客]
我也敢一路走回莫洛奇……
……
……除非……
你背我一下？

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
...kidding. I'm not that
big of a jerk, I guess.
Try not to look so
surprised!
scripts.translation:
[游客]
……开玩笑的。我想我还没那么混蛋。
别用那种惊讶的眼神看我！

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Where am I...?
...Who am I?
scripts.translation:
[游客]
我在哪里……？
……我是谁？

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
.....

[Tourist]
Mahahahahahaha!!
scripts.translation:
[游客]
玛哈哈哈哈哈！！

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
*Drools*...I love chocolate!
scripts.translation:
[游客]
*流口水*……我爱巧克力！

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Wait...
I have a girlfriend...
and...and...
cookies...?
I feel sooo lost...
scripts.translation:
[游客]
等等……
我有女朋友……
还有……还有……
饼干……？
我感觉好迷茫……

scripts.text: ^3355FFWe don't talk to crazy people~^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF我们才不跟疯子说话呢~^000000

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Where am I?
*Sob*...I guess I got lost...
Hey, where is this!?
scripts.translation:
[游客]
我在哪里？
*抽泣*……我想我迷路了……
嘿，这是哪里！？

scripts.text: Ignore him.
scripts.translation: 无视他

scripts.text: This is Alberta.
scripts.translation: 这里是艾尔贝塔。

scripts.text: This is Al De Baran.
scripts.translation: 这里是艾尔帕兰。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Ah...I see. So this is
Alberta...crud. I'm
supposed to go to ^0000FFLutie^000000...
scripts.translation:
[游客]
啊……原来如此。这里是艾尔贝塔……该死。我本来应该去^0000FF姜饼城^000000的……

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Hey, thanks for letting me know.
Now at least I know where I am.
Geez...they got boats here
that go everywhere, yeah?
scripts.translation:
[游客]
嘿，谢谢你告诉我。
至少我现在知道我在哪了。
天哪……这里有船可以去任何地方，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Oh right, everywhere...but Lutie.
Man, this stinks.
scripts.translation:
[游客]
哦对，任何地方……除了姜饼城。
天哪，这太糟糕了。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Oh...oh right!
Yeah, Al De Baran...
Guess I'm not lost
after all.
scripts.translation:
[游客]
哦……哦对！
是啊，艾尔帕兰……
看来我并没有迷路。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
I was told that I can see a ^FF0000Clock Tower^000000 in Al De Baran.
Can you tell me where I can find the ^FF0000Clock Tower^000000?
scripts.translation:
[游客]
我听说在艾尔帕兰可以看到一座^FF0000钟楼^000000。
你能告诉我^FF0000钟楼^000000在哪里吗？

scripts.text: It's in the center of the town.
scripts.translation: 它在城镇的中心。

scripts.text: Eh, I think I gave you the wrong town name.
scripts.translation: 呃，我想我告诉你错误的城镇名字了。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
..............
You know, I'm beginning
to feel like...
you're pullin' my
chain...
scripts.translation:
[游客]
…………
你知道吗，我开始觉得……
你在耍我……

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Hah~!...I knew it! Well, it's
pretty hard to admit when
you do something wrong.
Thanks for being honest, pal.
scripts.translation:
[游客]
哈~！……我就知道！好吧，做错事时承认确实很难。
谢谢你的诚实，伙计。

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
Wahhhh~~~!!
Dad~~ let me have a Munak~~~!
Waaahhhh!
scripts.translation:
[汤米]
哇哈哈~~~！！
爸爸~~给我一只僵尸~~~！
哇啊啊啊！

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
I want Munak, Munakkkk~~!!
Other people have a Munak, why can't I~~?
scripts.translation:
[汤米]
我要僵尸，僵尸~~！！
别人都有僵尸，为什么我没有~~？

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
Munak Munak Munak Munak~~~!
scripts.translation:
[汤米]
僵尸僵尸僵尸僵尸~~~！

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
Er...Ummm...
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
呃...那个...

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
Munak Munak Munak Munak~~~!
scripts.translation:
[汤米]
僵尸僵尸僵尸僵尸~~~！

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
Tommy, daddy is kind of busy right now...
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
汤米，爸爸现在有点忙...

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
Munak Munak Munak Munak~~~!
scripts.translation:
[汤米]
僵尸僵尸僵尸僵尸~~~！

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
*Sigh*...alright...alright. If you want it that bad...
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
*叹气*...好吧...好吧。如果你这么想要的话...

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
Gosh...being a dad is not an easy
thing to do...Hmmm? Do you have any business with me?
 
[Tommy]
^FF0000Munak Munak Munak Munak!!^000000
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
天哪...当爸爸真不是一件容易的事...嗯？你有事找我吗？
 
[汤米]
^FF0000僵尸僵尸僵尸僵尸！！^000000

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
....Sorry, what did you say? I have no idea what you're talking about.
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
....抱歉，你说什么？我完全没听懂你在说什么。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Pandger Mayer introduced you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
潘杰·梅尔介绍你来的。

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
Oh, you mean that guy in love?
Last time I saw him, he was
leaving to find cookies somewhere...
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
哦，你是说那个恋爱中的人？
上次见到他时，他正要去某个地方找绿饼人...

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
There is only one reason he could have mentioned my name to you...
 
 
[Tommy]
^FF0000Munak Munak Munak Munak!!^000000
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
他提到我的名字，肯定只有一个原因...
 
 
[汤米]
^FF0000僵尸僵尸僵尸僵尸！！^000000

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
......
*Sigh* For now, I have a favor to
ask of you. Could you bring me
^0000FF1 No Recipient^000000?
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
......
*叹气* 目前，我有件事想拜托你。你能帮我带一个^0000FF1魔物信件^000000来吗？

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
I need this kid to calm down first...
 
 
[Tommy]
^FF0000Munak Munak Munak Munak!!^000000
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
我得先让这孩子冷静下来...
 
 
[汤米]
^FF0000僵尸僵尸僵尸僵尸！！^000000

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
^FF0000Munak Munak Munak Munak!!^000000
scripts.translation:
[汤米]
^FF0000僵尸僵尸僵尸僵尸！！^000000

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
Oh, thank you so much...
Let me calm this kid down
first. Sorry my little boy is being so loud.
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
哦，太感谢你了...
让我先安抚一下这孩子。抱歉，我儿子这么吵闹。

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
Tommy, Tommy?
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
汤米，汤米？

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
^FF0000Moo^9F0000naah^5F0000ahhh^3F0000ahhh^000000kkk!!..Err?
What's this, Daddy?

[Jacob]
This is called No Recipient~
With this, I can get you a Munak~
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
这个叫做魔物信件~
有了它，我就能给你弄一只僵尸~

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
Are you serious, Daddy?!
scripts.translation:
[汤米]
你是认真的吗，爸爸？！

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
Yes, I am~
Have you ever heard me lie?
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
是的，我是认真的~
你听过我说谎吗？

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
.......
I know you always lie to Mommy.
scripts.translation:
[汤米]
......
我知道你总是骗妈妈。

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
..........
No no no no no...that's not
considered lying, Tommy.
I am just trying to make it sound better to Mommy~
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
..........
不不不不不...那不算说谎，汤米。
我只是想让事情听起来更好一点~

scripts.text:
^3355FFHe looks at his father in
doubt. Kids are too smart
to lie to nowadays...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF他怀疑地看着他的父亲。
现在的孩子太聪明了，骗不了他们...^000000

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
So, mister, do you think my Daddy can catch a Munak with this?
scripts.translation:
[汤米]
那么，先生，你觉得我爸爸能用这个抓到僵尸吗？

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
So, lady, do you think my Daddy can catch a Munak with this?
scripts.translation:
[汤米]
那么，女士，你觉得我爸爸能用这个抓到僵尸吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: ...not sure.
scripts.translation: 不确定

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
Heh!! I knew my Daddy
wouldn't tell me a lie!! Thank you!!
scripts.translation:
[汤米]
嘿！我就知道我爸爸不会骗我！谢谢你！

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
(...*Phew!* Thank you~)

[Tommy]
So tell me, mister. Did he lie to me, then?
scripts.translation:
[汤米]
那么告诉我，先生。他是不是骗我了？

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
So tell me, lady. Did he lie to me, then?
scripts.translation:
[汤米]
那么告诉我，女士。他是不是骗我了？

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
Wait...wait, Tommy, that's not true...
(^0000FFGosh, why are you doing this to me, help me already!!^000000)
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
等等...等等，汤米，那不是真的...
(^0000FF天哪，你为什么要这样对我，快帮帮我啊！！^000000)

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
Can we catch a Munak with this or
not, huh? Tell meeeeehhhh~~~!
scripts.translation:
[汤米]
到底能不能用这个抓到僵尸啊？告诉我嘛~~~！

scripts.text: Yes, we can.
scripts.translation: 是的，可以。

scripts.text: No, we can't.
scripts.translation: 不，不行。

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
Heh heh! I knew it!
Thank you~!!!
scripts.translation:
[汤米]
嘿嘿！我就知道！
谢谢你~！！！

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
Now I can have a Munak!
scripts.translation:
[汤米]
现在我可以有一只僵尸了！

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
(...*Phew* Thank you~)
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
(...*呼* 谢谢你~)

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
I knew it!! Daddy, you're a liar!!
scripts.translation:
[汤米]
我就知道！！爸爸，你是个骗子！！

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
I hate you...I hate you!!!
I wish Baphomet would take you somewhere and eat you!!
scripts.translation:
[汤米]
我讨厌你...我讨厌你！！！
我希望巴风特把你抓走吃掉！！

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
Shoot...Tommy, Tommy...
Listen to me....
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
该死...汤米，汤米...
听我说....

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
I don't wanna listen to you!!!
I hate yoooooouhhhh!!
scripts.translation:
[汤米]
我才不听你说话！！！
我讨厌你！！！

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
....You.

[Jacob]
I don't want to see your ugly face
around here any more...
Leave~!
How could you do this to me, huh?
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
我再也不想看到你这副丑脸了...
滚开~！
你怎么能这样对我，嗯？

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
I hate yoooooouhhhh!!
 
 
[Jacob]
Tommy...Tommy please...
Will you let me explain...?
scripts.translation:
[汤米]
我讨厌你！！！
 
 
[雅各布]
汤米...汤米，求你了...
让我解释一下好吗...？

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
I knew it!! Daddy, you're a liar!!
scripts.translation:
[汤米]
我就知道！！爸爸，你是个骗子！！

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
I hate you...I hate you!!!
I wish Baphomet will take you somewhere and eat you!!
scripts.translation:
[汤米]
我讨厌你...我讨厌你！！！
我希望巴风特把你抓走吃掉！！

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
Shoot...Tommy, Tommy...
Listen to me....
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
该死...汤米，汤米...
听我说....

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
I don't wanna listen to you!!!
I hate yoooooouhhhh!!
scripts.translation:
[汤米]
我才不听你说话！！！
我讨厌你！！！

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
....You.

[Jacob]
I don't want to see
your ugly face any more.
Leave!
How could you do this to me, huh?
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
我再也不想看到
你这副丑脸了。
滚开！
你怎么能这样对我，嗯？

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
I hate yoooooouhhhh!!
[Jacob]
Tommy...Tommy, please...
Will you let me explain...?
scripts.translation:
[汤米]
我讨厌你！！！
[雅各布]
汤米...汤米，求你了...
让我解释一下好吗...？

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
^FF0000Munak Munak Munak Munak!!^000000
scripts.translation:
[汤米]
^FF0000僵尸僵尸僵尸僵尸！！^000000

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
*Sigh*...that's my boy. Please get me a No Recipient as soon as you can!
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
*叹气*...那是我的儿子。请尽快帮我弄一封魔物信件！

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
^FF0000Munak Munak Munak Munak!!^000000
scripts.translation:
[汤米]
^FF0000僵尸僵尸僵尸僵尸！！^000000

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
....*Sigh* Okay.
I will give you a chance
to make up for your mistake.
Please get me a No Recipient as soon as you can.
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
....*叹气* 好吧。
我会给你一个机会
弥补你的错误。
请尽快帮我弄一封魔物信件。

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
....I don't want to talk to YOU
anymore. Get outta here~!
It's your fault my little
boy thinks I'm a big liar!
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
....我再也不想
和你说话了。快滚~！
都怪你，让我儿子
觉得我是个超级大骗子！

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
*Phew* Now I can leave him alone.
Kids nowadays are so impatient...I am worried about my son.
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
*呼* 现在我可以让他一个人待着了。
现在的孩子真是不耐烦...我很担心我的儿子。

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
However, I can't do anything
about his temper...I think
he's just too young to know
what he's doing.
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
不过，我对他的脾气
无能为力...我觉得
他只是太小了，不懂
自己在做什么。

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
I'm having a hard time trying to
be a good parent, and I'm
beginning to appreciate my
own parents' efforts to raise me.
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
我很难做一个好父母，
我开始感激
我父母当年
养育我的付出。

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
Respect your parents while they're
still alive. It's too late to be
sorry after you've lost them.
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
趁父母还在世时
要尊敬他们。失去他们之后
再后悔就太晚了。

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
I was a wild kid as well...my
parents had a hard time raising
me. I'm ashamed of what I've done
when I was young...
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
我小时候也很调皮...我
父母养育我很辛苦。我为我
年轻时的所作所为
感到羞愧...

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
Those days, my parents couldn't
afford to feed me three meals a
day. And there were many
creditors that always came
to our house early
early in the morning.
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
那时候，我父母
连一日三餐都供不起。而且有很多
债主总是
一大早
一大早就来我们家。

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
Have you every heard about
distraint-papers? As soon
as those creditors put that
distraint-paper on any of my
things,it would no longer be
mine.
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
你听说过
扣押单吗？只要
那些债主把那张
扣押单贴在我
任何物品上，它就不再
属于我了。

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
I hated my parents for not providing me with a sweet home,
and I became rebellious.
But, no matter how bad I was,
Even in those difficult circumstances...
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
我恨父母没有给我一个甜蜜的家，
于是变得叛逆。
但无论我有多糟糕，
即使在那样艰难的处境下...

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
They never gave up on me.
Later, they told me that I was their one and only hope...
even though I was more of a burden than anything else at the moment.
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
他们从未放弃过我。
后来，他们告诉我，我是他们唯一的希望...
尽管当时我更像是一个负担。

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
Daddy, do you realize you've told
that story hundreds of times already? *Piff~*
Stop it already~
scripts.translation:
[汤米]
爸爸，你难道没意识到
你已经讲过这个故事几百遍了吗？*噗~*
别讲了嘛~

scripts.text:
^3355FFTommy was jumping and running
around like a crazy rabbit and
eventually bumped against me.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF汤米像只疯兔子一样
上蹿下跳，
最后撞到了我。^000000

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
...Tommy, respect your dad.
This is the story of your father's life.
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
...汤米，要尊重你爸爸。
这是你父亲的人生故事。

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
A.aa.aand.!!!

[Jacob]
How many times have I told you
to behave in front of other people?!
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
我告诉过你多少次
在别人面前要守规矩了？！

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
Say you're sorry to him!
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
向他道歉！

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
Say you're sorry to her!
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
向她道歉！

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
*Piff~*

[Jacob]
I don't hear it~!!
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
我没听到~！！

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
...I'm sorry...*bows head*
scripts.translation:
[汤米]
...对不起...*低头*

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
Ah~ yes! Didn't you say Pandger Mayer introduced me to you?
He wouldn't introduce me to just anyone. Oh, you must be
...an adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
啊~对！潘杰·梅尔是你介绍给我的吧？
他可不是随便介绍人的。哦，你一定是
...一位冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
Right.
I have something to tell you.
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
没错。
我有件事要告诉你。

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
When you go west from Morocc, and
pass through a cave, you will
arrive at a town called Comodo.
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
当你从莫洛奇往西走，
穿过一个洞穴，
就会到达一个叫克魔岛的城镇。

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
When you get there, you will see an old man named ^0000FFElder Creek^000000.
As a Sage, he has gained the respect of many.
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
到了那里，你会见到一位名叫^0000FFElder Creek^000000的老人。
作为贤者，他深受许多人尊敬。

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
People say that many adventurers
are visiting this man for some
reason. Why don't you go talk to him and see if he has some wisdom for you?
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
人们说，许多冒险者
都因为某些原因
去拜访这位老人。你不妨去和他谈谈，
看看他是否有什么智慧可以传授给你？

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
Respect your parents when they're
still alive. It's too late to be sorry after you've lost them.
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
趁父母还在世时要尊敬他们。
失去他们之后再后悔就太晚了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(Hmmm...I just know that there's more that this guy can tell me...)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
(嗯...我觉得这个人还有更多话想告诉我...)

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
When you have a kid,
don't forget to teach them
this one thing:
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
当你有了孩子，
别忘了教给他们
这一件事：

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
'^0000FFBe good to other people.^000000'
'^0000FFTry to be in someone else's shoes before judging that person.^000000'
Do you understand?
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
'^0000FF善待他人。^000000'
'^0000FF在评判一个人之前，试着站在他的角度思考。^000000'
你明白了吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(There's more this guy can tell me, I just know it...)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
(我觉得这个人还有更多话想告诉我...)

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
Now, why don't you visit the Sage?
And I thank you for your kindness.
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
现在，你不妨去拜访一下贤者吧。
还有，谢谢你的善意。

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
He's in Comodo, if you didn't
catch that. An adventurer like you should be able to get there with no problem.
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
他在克魔岛，如果你没听清的话。
像你这样的冒险者应该能轻松到达那里。

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
Thank you for the favour you did
for me...although we couldn't
catch a Munak in the end...
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
谢谢你帮了我的忙...虽然最后没能抓到僵尸...

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
It seems he learned something
through the experience.
He no longer demands something
I cannot do for him, or
misbehaves.
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
看来他通过这段经历学到了一些东西。
他不再要求我做不到的事，
也不再胡闹了。

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
That was another favor you did for me, even if you didn't mean to. Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
这也是你帮我的另一个忙，尽管你并非有意为之。谢谢你。

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
*Yawns*....
Today is such a boring day~.
I guess I'd better go take a walk
with my son. Do you want to walk with me?
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
*打哈欠*....
今天真是无聊的一天~。
我想还是去和儿子散散步吧。你想和我一起去吗？

scripts.text:
[Jacob's son]
I'm happy to hear that, daddy~
scripts.translation:
[雅各布的儿子]
听到你这么说，我很高兴，爸爸~

scripts.text:
- Wait a moment! -
- Currently you're carrying -
- too many items with you. -
- Please enlighten your weight -
- and try again. -
scripts.translation:
- 请稍等！ -
- 您目前携带的物品 -
- 太多了。 -
- 请减轻负重 -
- 然后再试一次。 -

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Good day, adventurer.
What kind of business
do you have with me?
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
日安，冒险者。
你有什么事找我？

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Are you seeking fortune or
mental relief? If not, do
you wish to finish something
you've started?
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
你是来求财，还是寻求心灵慰藉？
如果不是，你是想完成某件未竟之事吗？

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Answer me, adventurer!
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
回答我，冒险者！

scripts.text: I seek fortune!
scripts.translation: 我寻求财富！

scripts.text: I seek...wisdom.
scripts.translation: 我寻求...智慧。

scripts.text: I want to finish what I've started.
scripts.translation: 我想完成未竟之事。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
You're honest...!
However, I suggest that you try not to be enamored with wealth.
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
你很诚实...！
不过，我建议你不要过于迷恋财富。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Do you know the exact meaning
of the old saying...
^0000FFToo much is as bad as too little^000000?
I will give you what you want if
you answer the way I expect you to.
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
你知道这句老话的确切含义吗...
^0000FF过犹不及^000000？
如果你能按我期望的方式回答，我会给你想要的。

scripts.text: It's necessary to have a lot!
scripts.translation: 拥有很多是必要的！

scripts.text: Too dumb to see the future.
scripts.translation: 太愚蠢，看不到未来。

scripts.text: Too much of a good thing can be bad.
scripts.translation: 好事过头也会变坏。

scripts.text: Cringe to the powerful.
scripts.translation: 向强者卑躬屈膝。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
...
Get out of my sight,
you greedy fool.
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
...
滚出我的视线，
你这个贪婪的蠢货。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Bah! The more ignorant they are, the more arrogantly they act!
Did you think that I would accept just any meaning?
Take care, you ignorant fool.
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
哼！越是无知的人，越是傲慢！
你以为我会接受随便什么解释吗？
小心点，你这个无知的蠢货。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
That's right. You know it pretty
well. That adage serves as a lesson in greed.
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
没错。你懂得挺多。
这句谚语正是对贪婪的警示。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
There is a man I've known for a
long time...he was so greedy for
money and fortune, he didn't care what other people thought of him.
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
我认识一个很久以前的人...
他对金钱和财富极度贪婪，完全不在乎别人怎么看。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Consequently, people around him
didn't like him at all. In the end, he lost his friends due to his greed.
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
结果，周围的人都很讨厌他。最终，他因为贪婪而失去了朋友。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Of course, this rule applies to
you as well. That sort of thing is a universal principle, after all.
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
当然，这个道理也适用于你。
毕竟，这是一种普遍的原则。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
.....
Did you think that I would accept just any meaning??
Take care, you ignorant fool.
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
.....
你以为我会接受随便什么解释吗？
小心点，你这个无知的蠢货。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
I see. I have been trying to help
other people who need advice in
order to improve their lives.
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
我明白了。我一直试图帮助那些需要建议的人，
以改善他们的生活。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Since you need my advice
as well, I will try to
impart my wisdom in a
way that you will understand.
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
既然你也需要我的建议，
我会试着用你能理解的方式
传授我的智慧。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Now, tell me what is bothering right now.
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
现在，告诉我，是什么困扰着你？

scripts.text: Boy/girlfriend issue.
scripts.translation: 恋爱问题。

scripts.text: Financial problem.
scripts.translation: 经济问题。

scripts.text: Bored to death.
scripts.translation: 无聊透顶。

scripts.text: Career issue.
scripts.translation: 职业问题。

scripts.text: I want money.
scripts.translation: 我想要钱。

scripts.text: Give me items, old man.
scripts.translation: 给我物品，老头。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
I'm envious of you! Still, young
folk like you are lucky to
have such problems...sadly,
no one but yourself can really
help you in those kinds of
situations...
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
我羡慕你！不过，像你这样的年轻人
有这种烦恼也是幸运的...
遗憾的是，除了你自己，
没有人能真正帮到你...

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
However, the advice I can give you
is this: Be honest with your
beloved. One lie leads to
another lie in no time.
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
不过，我能给你的建议是：
对你所爱的人诚实。
一个谎言会迅速导致另一个谎言。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
If you treat the person you love
as special to you, that person
will eventually come to
understand your feelings...
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
如果你把你爱的人视为特别的存在，
那个人最终会理解你的心意...

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
And, remember this...
Everyone has a different way of showing that they love someone.
So...don't be discouraged if your feelings aren't returned.
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
还有，请记住这一点...
每个人表达爱的方式都不同。
所以...如果你的心意没有得到回应，也不要气馁。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
But still, I believe being honest
is the best way to gain your
true love.
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
不过，我依然相信，
诚实是获得真爱
最好的方式。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
....well, that is all I can tell
you. I hope you will be happy
with that nugget of wisdom.
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
....好了，我能告诉你的
就这些了。希望你能从
这点智慧中获得幸福。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
...yes, everybody has their own
financial problems. However, think of it in this way:
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
...是的，每个人都有自己的
经济问题。不过，你可以这样想：

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Money is important to make
a living, but it's not what life is all about.
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
金钱对于谋生很重要，
但它并不是生活的全部。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Some may have the life goal of
making fortunes, but I don't think it's the happiest way of living.
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
有些人的人生目标是
发大财，但我不认为
这是最幸福的生活方式。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
As you see, there are powerful
people in this world who can control our lives. But oftentimes...
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
正如你所见，这个世界上
有能掌控我们命运的强大人物。但很多时候...

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
They are too greedy to be in that
position and they don't have
their priorities straight.
Instead of improving the world, they use their power to only help themselves.
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
他们身居高位却过于贪婪，
分不清轻重缓急。
他们不致力于改善世界，
反而只利用权力来谋取私利。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
If I were them, I wouldn't want to
rule the world in that way.
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
如果我是他们，
我也不想以这种方式统治世界。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Don't you think we need somebody who can change this world??
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
你不觉得我们需要
一个能改变这个世界的人吗？

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
.....I apologize for being short
tempered. I just wanted to let
you know that money is not everything. But, it is something you need to live.
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
.....抱歉我刚才有些急躁。
我只是想让你知道，金钱并非一切。
但它是生存所必需的。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
I'm aware that greedy people
ridicule this belief, saying
that it is a poor man's effort
to protect his pride.
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
我知道贪婪的人会嘲笑这种信念，
说这只是穷人
为了维护自尊而做的徒劳努力。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
But, I still believe I am right.
After all...I am a Sage.
I hope you will be happy with my wise advice.
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
但我依然坚信自己是对的。
毕竟...我是一名贤者。
希望你能从我的忠告中获得幸福。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Yes, we always need to be
entertained. But...it
seems you may not be satisfied with anything.
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
是的，我们总是需要
娱乐。但是...
看来你对任何事物都不满意。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
It's all about the various tastes
and interests people will have.
Things other people enjoy might not
displease you. Also, if your
mind is unwilling to be happy,
you will not enjoy life.
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
这全看个人的品味和兴趣。
别人喜欢的东西，
你不一定喜欢。而且，如果你的心
不愿快乐，你就无法享受人生。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Here's an example of having
the right frame of mind.
Let's say we're cleaning
the street for the town,
which can be hard, grueling work...
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
这里有一个拥有正确心态的例子。
假设我们在为城镇清扫街道，
这可能是一项艰苦繁重的工作...

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
You're always covered in dust.
In the summer, your body is
sticky with sweat...
In the winter, you'll be
be out in the freezing cold...
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
你总是满身灰尘。
夏天，身体被汗水浸湿...
冬天，你又要忍受刺骨的寒冷...

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
However, even so, it will be different to someone with a different perspective.
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
然而，即便如此，
对于拥有不同视角的人来说，
感受也会截然不同。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Ideally, we should try
to find joy in making
other people happy.
By cleaning the street, we can
give others a reason to smile.
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
理想情况下，我们应该
试着从让别人快乐中找到乐趣。
通过清扫街道，我们可以
给别人一个微笑的理由。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Tourists passing through the street
can enjoy its cleanliness...
Overall, it makes the entire community look good.
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
路过街道的游客
可以享受街道的整洁...
总的来说，这让整个社区看起来更美好。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
If your parents see you cleaning
the street, they will be proud of
their child.
...But now, I think I'm beginning to make no sense.
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
如果你的父母看到你
在清扫街道，
他们会为有这样的孩子感到骄傲。
...不过，我觉得我好像开始说胡话了。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Oh well, I apologize.
Just try to think positively.
With the right attitude, eventually you will find something to enjoy.
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
算了，抱歉。
试着往积极的一面想吧。
只要心态正确，
你终会找到值得享受的事物。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Haha~ I can see you're just
clicking the 'next' button on these
windows, because you're sick and tired of this NPC conversation.
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
哈哈~ 我看出来了，
你只是在疯狂点击“下一项”按钮，
因为你已经受够了这个NPC的对话。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
....anyway, that is all.
I hope you will be happy
with my wise advice.
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
...总之，就到这里吧。
希望我的忠告能让你感到快乐。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
That's an agonizing thought for every young person.
But you have a lot time to think about what you want to do in the future.
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
这对每个年轻人来说都是个痛苦的思考。
但你还有大把的时间，
去思考未来想做什么。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Experience more in many different
places, and read as many books
as you can. Focus on broadening your perspective.
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
去不同的地方多体验，
多读书。专注于拓宽你的视野。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Then, you will realize what you really want to do.
....that's all I can say.
I hope you will be happy with my wise advice.
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
那样，你就会明白自己真正想做什么。
...我能说的就这些了。
希望我的忠告能让你感到快乐。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
....
I see, you chose the wrong answer in the first place.
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
...
看来，你一开始就选错了答案。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
I believe this will be a lesson to be more honest with yourself.
Choose the right answer next time!
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
我相信这会是一堂
让你学会对自己诚实的课。
下次选对答案！

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
You rascal!
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
你这小无赖！

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Get out of my sight immediately! I don't talk to trash!
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
立刻从我眼前消失！
我不跟垃圾说话！

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Yes, you need to see things to the end.
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
是的，你需要把事情坚持到底。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
....*Sigh* Okay.
I forgive you.
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
... *叹气* 好吧。
我原谅你了。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
I do not wish to continue this conversation with you.
Get out of my sight immediately!
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
我不想再和你继续这个对话了。
立刻从我眼前消失！

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
...I was just testing you
in order to give you something
special. I'm the only person in the world that can give you this...
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
...我刚才只是在考验你，
为了给你一样特别的东西。
我是世界上唯一能给你这个的人...

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
I had to check if you are the right person as I initially thought.
....Hmm.
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
我必须确认你是否像我最初认为的那样，
是合适的人。
...嗯。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
But you don't expect me to give something special without any compensation, do you?
Would you bring the items I want?
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
但你不会指望我
不索取任何报酬就给你特别的东西吧？
你愿意帮我带点东西来吗？

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
It's not a hard thing to do.
That is...
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
这并不难。
也就是说...

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
10 Brigan,
15 Clam Shell,
10 Crab Shell
and 50 Cyfar.
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
10个布里刊，
15个蛤蜊外壳，
10个螃蟹外壳
和50个赛依伐。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Well, I am collecting those as my hobby.
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
嗯，我收集这些是我的爱好。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
I have no doubt that you will be able to gather them all.
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
我相信你一定能把它们全部收集齐。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Do me this favor, young man.
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
请帮个忙，年轻人。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
....hmm. I see you want more.
Come back later.
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
……嗯，看来你还想要更多。
请稍后再来。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Is there any business left between
us? Tell me, young adventurer...
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
我们之间还有什么事吗？
告诉我，年轻的冒险者……

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou feel there may be something you missed.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你感觉似乎有什么东西被遗漏了。^000000

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
I see you know how the world
works. When you need something
from someone, you must give
in order to receive.
Thank you for your kindness.
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
看来你很懂世故。
想要从别人那里得到什么，
就必须先给予。
谢谢你的善意。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Please, take this first.
If you would, please go talk to my
grandson later. He seemed to witness something horrible a while ago...
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
请先收下这个。
如果可以的话，
请稍后去和我的孙子谈谈。
他刚才似乎目睹了可怕的事情……

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
I have no idea what he saw,
because the shock took away
his ability to speak.
When he recovers, I will tell you.
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
我不知道他看到了什么，
因为巨大的冲击让他失去了说话的能力。
等他恢复后，我会告诉你的。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
In fact, the items I have asked
for will be used to cure
his condition. I don't
really collect these as a
hobby...
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
其实，我让你收集的那些物品，
是用来治疗他的病情的。
我并不是真的把它们当作爱好来收集……

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
I am sorry to cause you
much trouble for my own good.
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
为了我自己的事给你添了这么多麻烦，
我很抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Remember, when you want something,
especially when it's special, you
should always offer something in exchange.
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
记住，当你想要某样东西时，
尤其是特别的东西，
你应该总是提供某种交换。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
I want...
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
我想要……

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
10 Brigan,
15 Clam Shell,
10 Crab Shell and
50 Cyfar.
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
10个布里刊，
15个蛤蜊外壳，
10个螃蟹外壳
和50个赛依伐。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Feel free to come back anytime...
And if you need advice, I am more than willing to help you.
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
随时欢迎回来……
如果你需要建议，我非常乐意帮助你。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Do you wish for me to give you advice, adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
你想让我给你一些建议吗，冒险者？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Now, tell me what bothers you at the moment.
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
现在，告诉我你目前有什么烦恼。

scripts.text: Boy/girlfriend issue.
scripts.translation: 恋爱问题。

scripts.text: Financial problem.
scripts.translation: 经济问题。

scripts.text: Bored to death.
scripts.translation: 无聊透顶。

scripts.text: Career issue.
scripts.translation: 职业问题。

scripts.text: Give me items, old man.
scripts.translation: 给我物品，老头。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
I'm envious of you! Still, young
folk like you are lucky to
have such problems...sadly,
no one but yourself can really
help you in those kinds of
situations...
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
我羡慕你！不过，像你这样的年轻人
有这种烦恼也是幸运的...
遗憾的是，除了你自己，
没有人能真正帮到你...

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
However, the advice I can give you
is this: Be honest with your
beloved. One lie leads to
another lie in no time.
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
不过，我能给你的建议是：
对你所爱的人诚实。
一个谎言会迅速导致另一个谎言。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
If you treat the person you love
as special to you, that person
will eventually come to
understand your feelings...
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
如果你把你爱的人视为特别的存在，
那个人最终会理解你的心意...

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
And, remember this...
Everyone has a different way of showing that they love someone.
So...don't be discouraged if your feelings aren't returned.
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
还有，请记住这一点...
每个人表达爱的方式都不同。
所以...如果你的心意没有得到回应，也不要气馁。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
But still, I believe being honest
is the best way to gain your
true love.
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
不过，我依然相信，
诚实是获得真爱
最好的方式。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
....well, that is all I can tell
you. I hope you will be happy
with that nugget of wisdom.
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
....好了，我能告诉你的
就这些了。希望你能从
这点智慧中获得幸福。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
...yes, everybody has their own
financial problems. However, think of it in this way:
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
...是的，每个人都有自己的
经济问题。不过，你可以这样想：

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Money is important to make
a living, but it's not what life is all about.
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
金钱对于谋生很重要，
但它并不是生活的全部。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Some may have the life goal of
making fortunes, but I don't think it's the happiest way of living.
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
有些人的人生目标是
发大财，但我不认为
这是最幸福的生活方式。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
As you see, there are powerful
people in this world who can control our lives. But oftentimes...
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
正如你所见，这个世界上
有能掌控我们命运的强大人物。但很多时候...

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
They are too greedy to be in that
position and they don't have
their priorities straight.
Instead of improving the world, they use their power to only help themselves.
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
他们身居高位却过于贪婪，
分不清轻重缓急。
他们不致力于改善世界，
反而只利用权力来谋取私利。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
If I were them, I wouldn't want to
rule the world in that way.
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
如果我是他们，
我也不想以这种方式统治世界。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Don't you think we need somebody who can change this world??
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
你不觉得我们需要
一个能改变这个世界的人吗？

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
.....I apologize for being short
tempered. I just wanted to let
you know that money is not everything. But, it is something you need to live.
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
.....抱歉我刚才有些急躁。
我只是想让你知道，金钱并非一切。
但它是生存所必需的。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
I'm aware that greedy people
ridicule this belief, saying
that it is a poor man's effort
to protect his pride.
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
我知道贪婪的人会嘲笑这种信念，
说这只是穷人
为了维护自尊而做的徒劳努力。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
But, I still believe I am right.
After all...I am a Sage.
I hope you will be happy with my wise advice.
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
但我依然坚信自己是对的。
毕竟...我是一名贤者。
希望你能从我的忠告中获得幸福。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Yes, we always need to be
entertained. But...it seems
you may not be satisfied
with anything.
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
是的，我们总是需要娱乐。
但是……
似乎没有任何东西能让你感到满意。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
It's all about the various tastes
and interests people will have.
Things other people enjoy might
displease you. Also, if your
mind is unwilling to be happy,
you will not enjoy life.
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
这全在于每个人不同的品味和兴趣。
别人喜欢的东西可能会让你反感。
而且，如果你的心不愿意快乐，
你就无法享受人生。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Here's an example of having
the right frame of mind.
Let's say we're cleaning
the street for the town,
which can be hard, grueling work...
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
这里有一个拥有正确心态的例子。
假设我们在为城镇清扫街道，
这可能是一项艰苦繁重的工作...

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
You're always covered in dust.
In the summer, your body is
sticky with sweat...
In the winter, you'll be
be out in the freezing cold...
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
你总是满身灰尘。
夏天，身体被汗水浸湿...
冬天，你又要忍受刺骨的寒冷...

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
However, even so, it will be different to someone with a different perspective.
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
然而，即便如此，
对于拥有不同视角的人来说，
感受也会截然不同。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Ideally, we should try
to find joy in making
other people happy.
By cleaning the street, we can
give others a reason to smile.
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
理想情况下，我们应该
试着从让别人快乐中找到乐趣。
通过清扫街道，我们可以
给别人一个微笑的理由。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Tourists passing through the
street can enjoy its
cleanliness...
Overall, it makes the entire community look good.
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
路过这条街的游客可以欣赏它的整洁……
总的来说，这让整个社区看起来更好。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
If your parents see you cleaning
the street, they will be proud of
their child.
...But now, I think I'm beginning to make no sense.
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
如果你的父母看到你
在清扫街道，
他们会为有这样的孩子感到骄傲。
...不过，我觉得我好像开始说胡话了。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Oh well, I apologize.
Just try to think positively.
With the right attitude, eventually you will find something to enjoy.
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
算了，抱歉。
试着往积极的一面想吧。
只要心态正确，
你终会找到值得享受的事物。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Haha~ I can see you're just
clicking the 'next' button on
these windows, because you're sick and tired of this NPC conversation.
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
哈哈~ 我看你只是在点击这些窗口的“下一个”按钮，
因为你已经受够了这种NPC对话。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
....anyway, that is all.
I hope you will be happy
with my wise advice.
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
...总之，就到这里吧。
希望我的忠告能让你感到快乐。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
That's an agonizing thought for every young person.
But you have a lot time to think about what you want to do in the future.
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
这对每个年轻人来说都是个痛苦的思考。
但你还有大把的时间，
去思考未来想做什么。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Experience more in many different
places, and read as many books
as you can. Focus on broadening your perspective.
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
去不同的地方多体验，
多读书。专注于拓宽你的视野。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Then, you will realize what you really want to do.
....that's all I can say.
I hope you will be happy with my wise advice.
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
那样，你就会明白自己真正想做什么。
...我能说的就这些了。
希望我的忠告能让你感到快乐。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
You rascal!
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
你这小无赖！

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Get out of my sight immediately! I don't talk to trash!
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
立刻从我眼前消失！
我不跟垃圾说话！

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
I hope you will enjoy your life. Remember, time flies and you live only once.
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
愿你享受你的生活。
记住，时光飞逝，人生只有一次。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
I have been helping people by giving them advice to improve their lives.
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
我一直通过提供建议来帮助人们改善生活。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Since you need my help as well, I shall endeavor to impart some wisdom.
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
既然你需要我的帮助，我会尽力传授一些智慧。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Now tell me, what bothers you right now?
scripts.translation:
[长老 克里克]
现在告诉我，你目前有什么烦恼？

scripts.text: Boy/girlfriend issue.

scripts.text: Financial problem.
scripts.translation: 经济问题。

scripts.text: Bored to death.
scripts.translation: 无聊透顶。

scripts.text: Career issue.
scripts.translation: 职业问题。

*哭泣*...我要僵尸！....*哭泣*
我的朋友都有僵尸，我没有...
哇啊啊啊~~

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
Daddy, I hate you!!
I hate all of you!!!
scripts.translation:
[汤米]
爸爸，我讨厌你！！
我讨厌你们所有人！！！

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
Waaaahhh~~~!
I don't care what anybody's telling
me! I'll be bad because I hate everyone!
scripts.translation:
[汤米]
哇啊啊啊~~~！
我才不管别人怎么说！
我讨厌所有人，所以我要变坏！

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
Heh~!
I'm so happy~
We're gonna get a Munak~!
Heh heh heh~!
scripts.translation:
[汤米]
嘿嘿~！
我好开心~
我们要去抓僵尸了~！
嘿嘿嘿~！

Heh~!

Heh heh heh~!
scripts.translation:

嘿嘿嘿~！

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
Heh~!
I like you~ 
Cuz now we're gonna
get a Munak~
So happy! *smiles*
scripts.translation:
[汤米]
嘿嘿~！
我喜欢你~
因为现在我们要
去抓僵尸了~
好开心！*微笑*

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
Daddy...I won't ask you for something that's too hard for you.
scripts.translation:
[汤米]
爸爸...我不会向你索要太难的东西了。

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
I saw you're huffing and puffing when we went to catch a Munak.
I'm so sorry that I gave you a hard time, daddy...
scripts.translation:
[汤米]
我看你抓僵尸的时候很吃力。
爸爸，对不起，让你为难了...

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
I will be good from now on.
I will be nice to my Daddy, to you and to anyone.
scripts.translation:
[汤米]
从今以后我会乖的。
我会对爸爸好，对你好，对每个人都好。

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
My dad told me that I will be a good kid if I don't behave bad sometimes.
scripts.translation:
[汤米]
爸爸告诉我，只要我不调皮捣蛋，就会是个乖孩子。

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
I hate to see my daddy resting in his room all day in the weekends.
But I am so happy today because my daddy and I will take a walk together!!
scripts.translation:
[汤米]
我不喜欢看到爸爸周末整天都待在房间里休息。
不过今天我很开心，因为爸爸要和我一起去散步！！
